acceptance: The loading path and precedence for Codex, Gemini and Antigravity are recorded on this item, each with how it was observed.
The primary clone's `.agents/skills/todo/SKILL.md` matches the pinned catalog revision, done by the owner or with recorded authorization.

One durable option is chosen and delivered: after a later catalog pin change merges, a session in a checkout with a stale `.agents/skills` is told so, or the copy is refreshed without an agent write, or the harnesses no longer read it.
`make skill-sync-check` still passes in a checkout where `.agents/skills` is absent.
context:
Owner decisions 2026-11-17: (1) agent authorized to run `make skill-sync` once in the primary clone with BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE=1; (2) durable fix is option (a): `scripts/check_primary_clone_clean.sh report`, which every preflight runs, warns when the primary clone's `.agents/skills` differs from the pinned catalog. Report only; silent when `.agents/skills` is absent. Verification rubric: pass = a test with a stale copy produces the warning, a matching copy and an absent copy produce none, and the report never writes; fail = any regeneration or a non-zero exit from the report mode.

2026-11-17 immediate repair done under the owner's authorization. After fast-forwarding the primary clone to origin/develop (028bb5a2ca), `make skill-sync` still refused: the tracked `.claude/skills/blog/SKILL.md` intentionally differs from the pinned catalog (the blog drift is exempted in `make skill-sync-check`, see blog-skill-site-paths-20261017), and `skill-sync apply` refuses to overwrite it, so `make skill-sync` cannot succeed on develop in any checkout. Repaired by running `tools/skill-sync apply -f <copy of skill-sync.conf without the .claude/skills target>` plus copying skill-sync.config.yaml, which wrote only the ignored `.agents/skills` (55 files); `git status` stayed clean; `.agents/skills/todo` now matches `.claude/skills/todo` and contains the subagent member rule. Durable check design: compare the rev lines in `.agents/skills/skill-sync.receipt` with those in `skill-sync.conf` (offline, no catalog read), not a full preview.
description:
`AGENTS.md` says `.agents/skills` is the shared, gitignored materialization that Codex, Gemini and Antigravity read, regenerated by `make skill-sync` in a write worktree. Sessions start in the primary clone, which is read-only for agents, so nothing ever regenerates the copy there. On 2026-11-15 `/Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox/.agents/skills/todo/SKILL.md` was dated 2026-10-01, while the tracked `.claude/skills/todo/SKILL.md` on `develop` last changed on 2026-11-14. The stale copy lacks the 2026-11-12 batch member rule ('such as a subagent ... make no tracker writes'), so a Codex, Gemini or Antigravity session started in the primary clone still reads the superseded text. Claude Code and omp read the tracked mirror and are not affected.

Not verified: which directory each of those three harnesses actually loads project skills from when started in the primary clone, and whether they also read the global `~/.agents/skills` (refreshed 2026-11-13) with which precedence. Establish that first; if the global copy wins, the impact is smaller than stated.

Decision gates.
- Immediate repair is an owner action: run `make skill-sync` in the primary clone (it writes only the ignored `.agents/skills` and should leave the tracked mirror unchanged if the clone is at `origin/develop`). An agent does not do this without explicit authorization plus `BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE=1`.
- Durable fix, choose one: (a) a check that reports when `.agents/skills` in the current checkout differs from what `skill-sync.conf` pins, wired where a session would see it (the write preflight already warns about a stale primary clone, see #4207); (b) refresh the ignored copy as part of the owner's routine that fast-forwards the primary clone; (c) stop relying on the ignored copy and point those harnesses at the tracked mirror.

Guardrails.
- Never hand-edit `.agents/skills` or `.claude/skills`.
- No agent write in the primary clone under this item without the explicit authorization above.
- A staleness check reports only; it does not regenerate, and it must work when `.agents/skills` is absent (CI, cloud clones).
